merge.why: USER RULING 2026-10-09: 'I think Prodigious growth and Mythic Proportions could be merged.' Both are the deck's big green trample Auras (Prodigious Growth +7/+7, Mythic Proportions +8/+8); the keep decision treats them as the same card.

keep_apart.why: USER RULING 2026-10-09: 'I wouldn't merge birds and avacyn's as much as it is tempting to do so. Missing blue is a real problem for this deck.' Birds makes any colour (blue included); Pilgrim makes only white.
